newsitem.title: UK: UK M0 rises to s/a 25.416 bln stg in wk to June 4.
newsitem.headline: UK M0 rises to s/a 25.416 bln stg in wk to June 4.

text.p: British M0 money supply rose to a provisional seasonally adjusted 25.416 billion stg in the week to June 4 from 25.212 billion the previous week, the Bank of England said.
On an unadjusted basis M0 fell to 25.389 billion stg from 25.438 billion.
Notes and coins in circulation rose to 25.275 billion stg on a seasonally adjusted basis from 25.185 billion the previous week and fell to 25.248 billion from 25.411 billion on an unadjusted basis.
